meta.name: Best Medicine
meta.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they’ve got.

videos.title: Docked
videos.overview: Brilliant and brusque renowned surgeon Martin Best leaves his lucrative career in Boston to become the general practitioner in the small seaside village of Port Wenn, Maine. One local teacher, Louisa Gavin questions his harsh demeanor, while Martin quickly gets annoyed by the antics of its town locals, all while hiding his debilitating aversion to blood.

videos.title: Bean There, Done That
videos.overview: After Martin comes face to face with his childhood bully and diagnoses a potentially contagious illness, he is forced to cancel Port Wenn's monthly baked bean supper, angering everyone in the town. Also, Louisa observes Mark getting friendly with her teaching assistant, while Elaine steps in to help Martin in an unexpected, but very much needed, way.

videos.title: Take Me Out of the Ballgame
videos.overview: On the eve of Port Wenn High School’s baseball team’s playoff game, the town is furious with Martin when he accidentally breaks the arm of their star player, who happens to be the son of his high school bully. However, Martin suspects the boy has a more serious condition. Meanwhile, Elaine moves into Martin’s waiting room after fighting with her mom, Aunt Sarah rivals with a fan of the opposing team, and Louisa makes a conscious effort to make some female friends.

videos.title: All the World's Ablaze
videos.overview: Port Wenn's favorite hunky wilderness survival instructor goes missing after Martin deduces that he desperately needs medical help. Also, the locals are furious with Martin after he calls the health inspector on The Salty Breeze suspecting food poisoning and Elaine decides to skip her mother's wedding to the school principal.

videos.title: Hello Darkness, My Port Wenn
videos.overview: While conducting a wellness check on the agoraphobic recluse who controls the town power grid and has stopped taking his meds, Martin's brusque bedside manner ultimately causes a massive town black out. As the townspeople fight for electricity, Martin befriends a young boy who reminds him of himself. Then, Louisa and Mark share a romantic moment in the dark.

videos.title: Eyewitness Blues
videos.overview: On the eve of Port Wenn's annual blueberry festival, Martin treats a local man who has apparently become blue from eating too many blueberries. Also, Martin is disturbed by Aunt Sarah's lack of attention to her health, Mark faces the repercussions when his vision issues may stem from his sexual history and Louisa is determined to win the pie competition.

videos.title: There Might Be Blood
videos.overview: When Port Wenn puts on their annual 'Blood Factory,' celebrating the gory horror novel set there, Martin must contain his secret debilitating blood phobia when Louisa gets seriously ill and needs his help. Meanwhile, the town is all atwitter when the novel's author is rumored to be making a surprise visit to the event.

videos.title: The Bogfather
videos.overview: Port Wenn eagerly goes into high alert when a corpse is found in the town's bog and Martin's autopsy reveals that he was murdered. Meanwhile, Martin's solo investigation trek leads him to startling discovery about himself and the new neighborhood watch turns into a gossip-seeking mission.

videos.title: Doc Martin
videos.overview: When Martin’s parents make a surprise visit, Martin suspects that his father, Robert, after blindsiding his sister Sarah with some infuriating news, is experiencing a serious health condition. Also, while trying to avoid the school’s forthcoming closure amidst its annual Spirit Week sleepover, Louisa is made acting principal, and Martin and Robert must operate together on Mark.

videos.title: Port Wenn-ings and a Funeral
videos.overview: After Martin invites Louisa to watch the annual bird migration over Port Wenn, he treats an elderly woman whose hallucinations lead to dire consequences. Meanwhile, Aunt Sarah fumes after the reading of a will leaves her nothing and Martin must perform an emergency procedure on his young friend.

videos.title: Mind Your Own Buboes
videos.overview: Port Wenn goes on lockdown when a patient with fleas sparks fears of a plague outbreak and Martin must deal with the town gossip when it revolves around him and Louisa. Also, Aunt Sarah feels betrayed by Greg and George and Louisa has an epiphany.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Sister Cities
videos.overview: Martin is skeptical when Port Wenn welcomes an extremely friendly delegation from their sister city in Norway and Louisa visits a specialist who just happens to be Martin's ex. Also, Greg believes that he is pooping little men and Mark exhibits troubling symptoms that warrant an intervention.

videos.title: Norway No How
videos.overview: As the furious people of Port Wenn discover the truth about their deal with their Norwegian sister city, Martin must toggle between the potential revelation of his blood phobia, a startling baby delivery and the arrival of his amorous ex. Also, Louisa receives some thought-provoking medical results and Al and Elaine must navigate their uncertain future.

videos.title: Be Careful What You Fish For
videos.overview: While Martin continues to struggle with his blood phobia, a mermaid washes ashore in Port Wenn to the amazement of everyone in town. Meanwhile, Judith, a well-meaning townsperson, creates havoc while on prescribed oxygen, Louisa continues to see Martin's girlfriend Eden for medical guidance and Greg and George's success from the seas urchin boom take its toll on the both of them.

videos.title: Breakin' in Is Hard to Do
videos.overview: When the Port Wenn pharmacy is robbed, including Louisa’s critical time-sensitive medicine, Martin deduces that the culprit desperately needs his help.  Meanwhile, Greg and George clash with a rival food truck owner, Sarah tries to bond with Eden, and Martin is on the receiving end of a special brand of Port Wenn affection.

videos.title: Crate Expectations
videos.overview: As the citizens of Port Wenn get competitive during their annual floating crate race, Martin urgently tries to give important medical advice when three men have positive pregnancy tests. Meanwhile, Eden learns she wants to be liked after her singing 'causes' a man to pass out and former record-holder Sarah coaches Peter in the art of crate racing.

videos.title: No Place Like Om
videos.overview: As Martin desperately tries to leave Port Wenn to meet Eden in Boston for the weekend, he must first investigate the extremely strange behavior of three patients who have all recently visited a meditation retreat. Also, Mark is affected by the high school's graduation and Sarah's first guest in her rented spare room is none other than ex-paramour Eddie McCroy.

videos.title: Hare Today, Gone Tomorrow
videos.overview: When the wife of a traveling magician duo dies at the Salty Breeze, Martin must help the husband who is unable to grasp that she is gone. Also, Eden finds a letter Martin wrote to Louisa thinking it was for her and Martin gets a new medical monitor who has an instant connection to Louisa.

videos.title: Can't Stop the Healing
videos.overview: Martin works to debunk the sudden miraculous cures for the people of Port Wenn when self-proclaimed homeopath Savannah returns to town. Also Martin becomes acutely aware of Louisa and Parker's new connection and an influential food critic visits the Salty Breeze just as George loses his sense of taste.

videos.title: Love Is a Battlefield
videos.overview: Martin becomes concerned when during the Port Wenn Revolutionary War reenactment, some of the citizens start displaying tremors and odder than usual behavior. Also, Martin is affected by Louisa's new relationship with Parker, and Elaine and Al worry that Bert will be lonely when they leave for New York City.

videos.title: Back to the Suture
videos.overview: When he discovers that his predecessor, the beloved Dr. Reese, had diagnosed a patient's brain tumor moments before he died, Martin, with Louisa's help, must deduce who it was in order to save them.
